# Fuzz corpus for internal/storage fuzz targets.
# Each entry corresponds to a Go fuzz seed added via f.Add() in fuzz_test.go.
# The corpus is committed to satisfy AGENTS.md §8: "At least one corpus
# per fuzzer committed under testdata/fuzz/."
#
# FuzzCodecRoundTrip seeds:
# - 200 OK with normal body and headers
# - 404 with empty body
# - 301 redirect with no-cache
# - 500 with null bytes in body
# - 200 with large body (exercises heap path)
# - 204 No Content (empty body)
#
# FuzzDecodeObjectArbitrary seeds:
# - empty bytes
# - single version byte
# - truncated valid blob
# - wrong version byte (0xFE)
# - random text
# - valid blob with trailing garbage
